ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface covering approximately 92% of the visible fluke, with high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters and linear segments accounting for the remaining 8%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark gray to black region across the fluke body. High-intensity geometric clusters are mapped to the distal-most tips of both lobes. Multiple disconnected white linear segments are mapped primarily on the right-side lobe and center-bottom region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees, extending to a pixel depth of approximately 12% of the fluke's vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with frequent variations; pixel-amplitude peaks (serrations) are observed every 15-40 pixels along the boundary, with deeper valleys noted on the medial side of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe margins exhibit an upward-tilted convex sweep from the midline toward the tips, concluding in a sharp, slightly reflexed orientation at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-intensity pixels (barnacle colonies) localized exclusively at the extreme distal corners (tips) of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple high-contrast white linear disruptions; three prominent parallel vertical marks on the right lobe, and several unaligned diagonal and horizontal scratches across the central and left lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface trauma visible as parallel vertical rake marks on the right fluke lobe and heavy epibiotic (barnacle) colonization at the lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme distal tips of both lobes show significant textural thickening and volumetric irregularity compared to the primary fluke surface due to dense white pixel clustering.
